snippet.title: Longplay of Guruguru Town Hanamaru-kun
snippet.description:
Longplay of Guruguru Town Hanamaru-kun, played as the NTSC-J version on the Game Boy Color. This game's version was released on Apr. 27th, 2001 . Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!
